preconditions.description: The number of test cases t is between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= n <= 100 for n in [int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)])
preconditions.description: Each matrix size n is between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(len(b) == n and all(len(row) == n and all(c in '01' for c in row) for row in b) for n, b in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(sum(int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)))])
preconditions.description: Each matrix b is an n x n binary matrix.

postconditions.expression: all(len(A_i) >= 1 and len(A_i) <= n and all(1 <= x <= n for x in A_i) for n, A in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip().split() for _ in range(sum(int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)))]) for A_i in A)
postconditions.description: Each set A_i is nonempty and consists of distinct integers between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(len(set(map(tuple, A))) == len(A) for A in [input().strip().split() for _ in range(sum(int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)))])

all(all((b[i][j] == '1') == (set(A[i]) < set(A[j])) for j in range(n)) for i in range(n) for n, b, A in zip([int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)], [input().strip() for _ in range(sum(int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)))], [input().strip().split() for _ in range(sum(int(input().strip()) for _ in range(t)))])
postconditions.description: For all pairs (i, j), b[i][j] is 1 if and only if A_i is a proper subset of A_j.
